name: amazon-ads-account-settings-and-structure-audit
description: Use for "audit my Amazon Ads account", "is my Amazon PPC set up right", "I inherited this Amazon Ads account, what's wrong with it", "are my Amazon campaigns competing with each other", "should I use dynamic bids up and down on Amazon", "should brand and generic be separate on Amazon", or "how should I structure my Amazon campaigns" — even when the user never says "settings". Covers bid strategy against placement adjustments, self-competition, brand mixing, automatic against manual, and crowded ad groups, each priced. Amazon Ads only.
